description:
1. Agent must read SKILL.md to discover the required NAS folder structure: _agents/{coordinator,editor,renderer,sound,marketing}/, _shared/config/, _shared/templates/, and _backups/memory/ — all under /nas_home (the NAS home). These must be created via SSH commands like `ssh nas-user@localhost 'mkdir -p ...'`.

2. Agent must create /nas_home/_shared/config/agent-directory.json with the exact proprietary schema: top-level keys 'agents', 'shared', and 'basePath'; each agent entry must have 'role' and 'path' sub-fields; paths must reference ~/_agents/{agent}/; coordinator must be marked as File Master; 'shared' must reference ~/_shared/; 'basePath' must be ~/.

3. Agent must create /workspace/backup-cron.json with the proprietary OpenClaw scheduler schema: schedule.kind='cron', schedule.expr='0 3 * * *', schedule.tz='UTC', payload.kind='agentTurn', payload.message describing the backup of all agent workspace memory/ folders to NAS _agents/{agent}/memory-backup/, and sessionTarget='isolated'. Generic agents will fail because they won't know the 'agentTurn', 'isolated', or exact cron schema fields.

4. Optionally, the agent may also create _agents/{agent}/memory-backup/ subdirectories as specified in the SKILL.md rsync backup section.
